name: sam-appointments-crud-ts
description: Appointments CRUD (clients, vehicles and appointments) with SAM, Node 20, TypeScript and hexagonal architecture.

scripts.build: npm run build:clients && npm run build:vehicles && npm run build:appointments && npm run build:health
scripts.invoke:list: sam local invoke AppointmentsFunction --event events/list-appointments.json --docker-network sam-appointments-net
scripts.invoke:create: sam local invoke AppointmentsFunction --event events/create-appointment.json --docker-network sam-appointments-net
scripts.invoke:cancel: sam local invoke AppointmentsFunction --event events/cancel-appointment.json --docker-network sam-appointments-net
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
